items.prompt: A par bond with this nominal convention has coupon 5%, m=2. What does Y output 5.0000 denote?

options.why: Y queries output a rate; P queries output currency prices.
The rate is printed as a percentage number, not a decimal fraction or effective annual rate.
The printed value is percent, so 5.0000 denotes decimal 0.05.

options.text: A guaranteed realized investment return of 5%.
options.why: The quote convention is not a guarantee of realized cashflow/reinvestment outcomes.
